ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  This document confirms Asian Energy Services Limited's compliance with SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, indicating that their Registrar and Share Transfer Agent properly processed all dematerialization requests and updated the share register within prescribed timelines.
